title: Browser body probe
description: What the browser tool reports about the browser behind a door. It prints this object as JSON on the last line of its output, after the tag 'SEERESS_PROBE '. Seeress reads it before any model request: a door only runs a step when the browser proves it is the one the door allows.

daemon.description: The name of the daemon the browser tool routed the call to. Each door that owns a browser has its own.

kind.description: What the daemon reports about itself. 'local': a browser it discovered on this machine. 'cdp': a browser it was attached to by address. 'cloud': a browser in the vendor's cloud. The user's own Chrome and a Chromium of Seeress's own both report 'cdp', which is why the marker exists.

marker.description: The value of the marker cookie for http://seeress.invalid/, or null when there is none or it could not be read. Seeress compares it with the marker it issued for a browser of its own; any marker at all in the browser behind the personal door is a refusal.

error.description: Why the marker could not be read, or null when it could be. A probe with an error never proves anything.
